articles.title: Pentagon’s wireless services left locations, data exposed, watchdog finds
articles.summary: Security vulnerabilities meant that malicious groups could “pinpoint sensitive locations like safe houses or command posts, and expose operational vulnerabilities, significantly compromising national security.” The post Pentagon’s wireless services left locations, data exposed, watchdog finds appeared first on Task & Purpose .

articles.title: Maine National Guard, Coast Guard strengthen search and rescue partnership through joint training
articles.summary: The Maine National Guard and U.S. Coast Guard conducted a joint search and rescue training exercise Oct. 7, simulating a search for a missing kayaker at Acadia National Park to strengthen coordination between the two organizations and improve emergency response capabilities.

articles.title: USAG Hawaii DPW releases lead service line inventory public notification
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Garrison (USAG) Hawaii has updated the Lead Service Line Inventories. (LSLI) required by U.S. EPA’s Lead and Copper Rule Revisions for its water systems and are now available for review. The deadline for the inventories update is October 16, 2026.
